metrics.deployMAE: Median of the per-DEM mean absolute error of the product as delivered. Shifts, offsets, and tilts were not removed.
metrics.labelMAE: Error after the prediction is rescaled to the mean and standard deviation of the reference, after co-registration. Reported for MESA. MOLA is evaluated as distributed (deployMAE).
metrics.sub_km_r: Correlation with the reference at wavelengths below ~1 km.

accuracy.title: Accuracy against independent stereo DEMs
rows: Held-out CTX stereo DEMs, released DEM
Held-out CTX stereo DEMs, single-image predictions (whole images)
notes: Values are medians. The released DEM is scored in place on its predicted pixels. Single-image predictions are whole CTX images scored against the full stereo DEM of each pair, before the images are joined into the mosaic. *labelMAE against HiRISE is computed for the 581 DEMs with orthoimages co-registered to the CTX image.

notes: Pooled over the HiRISE DEMs in difference-of-Gaussian bands. Error is the RMS difference, amplitude is relative to HiRISE.

product.title: The product
rows: 18 m, simple cylindrical on the Mars sphere (R = 3,396,190 m), 1,185,494 × 592,747 pixels
48,002 CTX images, 2006–2025, one prediction per image and tile (57,945)
MOLA areoid, leveled to MOLA PEDR laser shots: median residual −0.08 m, robust SD 2.27 m
97.6% predicted from CTX images and 2.3% infilled (1.1% within 30° of the equator, 3.6% at 30–60°, 3.7% poleward of 60°). Data are available equatorward of ~88.6° latitude.
Provenance mask (CTX-derived or infilled), per-pixel expected error, and uncertainty class.
Fine-scale amplitude is low (37% of the HiRISE amplitude below 144 m). The improvement over MOLA is small poleward of 80°. Infilled areas are suitable for context and unsuitable for morphometry.
